_comment: Metaplex Sugar v2 — Candy Machine v3 Config for REBORNFENIX (RBFX) — v2.0
_deploy_note: Replace all PLACEHOLDER values before deployment. Run 'sugar validate' before 'sugar deploy'.
_architecture: Two guard groups: 'legion' (22,222 × 10 USDC) + 'founding_warrior' (22 × 100 USDC, max 1/wallet).
_number_note: 22,222 Legion of Honour + 22 Founding Warriors = 22,244 total tokens
_isSequential_note: Sequential minting ensures generation colours are assigned in purchase order (Gen 1 → Gen 10).
_hiddenSettings_note: Hidden settings enable pre-mint deployment without uploading all metadata upfront.
After mint is complete, update the base URI to the revealed metadata folder.
hash must be the SHA-256 of the concatenation of all metadata URIs.
Run 'sugar reveal' to trigger the on-chain reveal after all mints complete.
Replace 'REBORNFENIX_BASE_URI_PLACEHOLDER' with your Arweave/IPFS base URI after upload.
_uploadMethod_note: Bundlr (now Irys) for permanent Arweave storage. Alternatives: 'aws', 'nft_storage', 'pinata'.
_treasury_note: All mint proceeds go here. Use a multisig for production.
_goLiveDate_note: Replace with actual go-live UTC timestamp. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ
_gatekeeper_note: Optional: set to Civic Gateway config for bot protection. null = no captcha.

_note: Two guard groups for the two tiers.
'legion' group: public mint, 10 USDC each, no per-wallet cap (default reasonable limit set).
'founding_warrior' group: 100 USDC each, max 1 per wallet, supply hard-capped at 22.

legion.label: legion
legion._description: Public mint — Legion of Honour. 22,222 tokens @ 10 USDC each.

startDate._note: Replace with actual public mint start date.

tokenPayment._note: 10 USDC (6 decimals = 10,000,000). Mint address is USDC on Solana mainnet.

mintLimit._note: Max 10 Legion mints per wallet per transaction batch. Adjust for your launch strategy.

allocation._note: Hard supply cap for this guard group: 22,222 Legion tokens only.

botTax._note: 0.01 SOL bot tax to deter automated spam minting.

founding_warrior.label: founding_warrior
founding_warrior._description: Patron mint — Founding Warriors. 22 tokens @ 100 USDC each. Max 1 per wallet.

startDate._note: Founding Warriors can mint at same time as Legion, or open earlier for patrons.

tokenPayment._note: 100 USDC (6 decimals = 100,000,000). Mint address is USDC on Solana mainnet.

mintLimit._note: STRICT: max 1 Founding Warrior per wallet. Imperial Purple is for the few.

allocation._note: Hard supply cap for this guard group: 22 Founding Warriors only. Ever.

collection.name: REBORNFENIX
collection._note: Create the collection NFT first with 'sugar collection create', paste its mint address here.

_ruleSet_note: Metaplex Programmable NFT rule set address for royalty enforcement. null for legacy NFTs.
_tokenStandard_note: pNFT standard for on-chain royalty enforcement. Use 'NonFungible' for standard NFTs.

pricing._note: USDC mint address is for Solana mainnet. Use different address for devnet testing.

founding_warrior.name: Founding Warrior
founding_warrior.note: Post-purchase personalisation required: patron provides name + zodiac sign. Art generated after payment confirmed.

royalties._note: 500 basis points = 5% royalties on secondary sales. Enforced via pNFT standard.

deploymentChecklist: 1. Replace ALL PLACEHOLDER values in this config
2. Upload art assets to Arweave/IPFS and get base URIs (legion + founding warrior separate folders)
3. Upload Legion metadata JSONs using 'sugar upload' (22,222 files)
4. Upload Founding Warrior template JSONs separately (22 files, will be updated post-purchase)
8. Verify two guard groups are correctly configured: 'sugar show'
9. Test Legion mint (10 USDC) and Founding Warrior mint (100 USDC) on devnet
10. Verify mintLimit id:2 (Founding Warrior) enforces max 1 per wallet
11. Verify allocation id:2 hard-caps at 22 Founding Warriors
13. After Founding Warrior purchase: collect patron name + zodiac, generate personalised art, update metadata URI
14. After full sellout: run 'sugar reveal' for metadata reveal
15. Verify secondary marketplace royalties are enforced

network.rpc_note: Use a private RPC (Helius, QuickNode, Alchemy) for production. Public RPC rate-limits during high traffic.

lore.founding_warrior_tagline: 22 patrons. Imperial Purple. Built the fire that made it possible.
lore.founding_warrior_tagline_pt: 22 patronos. Púrpura Imperial. Construíram o fogo que tornou tudo possível.
lore.mission: Born from the fires of Ragnarök. Carrying the wisdom of the Elder Futhark. For every father who kept fighting when the world said stop.
lore.mission_pt: Nascidos dos fogos de Ragnarök. Carregando a sabedoria das Elder Futhark. Por cada pai que continuou a lutar quando o mundo disse para parar.
lore.imperial_purple_lore: In ancient Rome, wearing purple without being Emperor was punishable by death. The 22 Founding Warriors carry this color — not because they claimed it, but because they built the fire that made it possible.
lore.imperial_purple_lore_pt: Na Roma antiga, usar púrpura sem ser Imperador era punível com a morte. Os 22 Founding Warriors carregam esta cor — não porque a reclamaram, mas porque construíram o fogo que a tornou possível.
